about: Calibrated by vision/tools/calibrate_detector.py on vision_calib_1101_v2/q1505_cctv_checkin_overview, vision_calib_1101_v2/q1505_cctv_hall_east, vision_calib_1101_v2/q1505_cctv_security_queue, vision_calib_1101_v2/q1505_cctv_upper_4, vision_calib_1101_v1/r1530_cctv_security_queue, vision_calib_1101_v1/r1530_cctv_upper_2, vision_calib_1101_v1/r1530_cctv_upper_3, vision_calib_1101_v1/r1530_cctv_upper_4; YOLO11s COCO at 960 px, cpu. Box height = projected body. fp_per_frame kept at 0.02: the export labels only the people in range, and YOLO's boxes on the far, unlabelled people (1.09 per frame) are not false positives. Not installed in Unity: the training runs use the first guesses.
